compliance frameworks were designed around human-initiated transactions, with review cycles measured in hours or days.
autonomous agents settle payments in seconds and can execute thousands of transactions before a manual review queue clears its first item. that timing mismatch moves the enforcement point: screening has to happen inside the payment flow, at the moment a counterparty is evaluated and before funds settle. wallet risk data, sanctions lists, and spend policies all become inputs to the transaction itself, checked programmatically on every call. 
the audit trail improves as a side effect, since every payment carries its own screening decision and policy context. 

agentic commerce will scale on rails where compliance is a property of the transaction, and the teams building on x402 are already treating it that way.
